native.dp_role: Actual cyclic class1 master, acyclic class2 master or passive slave.
native.dp_state: Actual parameter/configuration/data-exchange state, not mere carrier presence.
native.dp_fdl: Actual FDL acknowledged, unacknowledged or reply service; SC has service-specific meaning.
native.dp_frame: Actual selected FDL frame format, distinct DP user bytes.
native.dp_parity: Actual even UART parity; NRZ is distinct Manchester PA.
native.dp_watchdog_impl: Actual watchdog implementation, not a guessed common timer.
native.dp_watchdog_state: Actual SPC3 baud-search, baud-control or DP-control state.

native.dp_address_source: Actual unique station addresses, active logical token ring and owning cyclic master.
native.dp_schedule_source: Actual polling/token/GAP/acyclic/error/retry traffic and worst-case bus schedule.
native.dp_mapping_source: Actual GSD module layout, Ident_Number, byte order and configured I/O correspondence.
native.dp_acceptance_source: Actual correlated consumer freshness/deadline and watchdog response, not FDL success.
native.dp_registered_source: Actual selected bearer/configurator/codec bounds where no reviewed manufacturer profile applies.
native.dp_rate_source: Actual supported and agreed rate at every relevant station, not master auto-lowering.
native.dp_watchdog_source: Actual selected watchdog implementation/base/configuration and response.
native.dp_station: Actual station address;126 commissioning,127 broadcast not operational node.
native.dp_master_station: Actual cyclic owner address, not a generated address default.
native.dp_hsa: Highest ACTIVE station ceiling; passive slave may exceed HSA.
native.dp_destination: Actual low7-bit FDL destination;127 only no-reply broadcast.
native.dp_source_station: Actual low7-bit FDL source, never broadcast.
native.dp_active_masters: Actual token-ring active masters; not forcibly one master network.
native.dp_token_holders: Actual simultaneous bus authority, not number of configured masters.
native.dp_network_stations: Actual addressed stations across repeated segments.
native.dp_segment_stations: Actual RS485 station electrical loads on this segment.
native.dp_repeater_loads: Actual repeater electrical loads on this segment, counted toward32.
native.dp_segment_loads: Actual station plus repeater loads; not addressed-station total.
native.dp_terminations: Actual powered RS485 line-end terminators, one at each of two ends.
native.dp_input_bytes: Actual slave-to-master cyclic user bytes, not combined duplex maximum.
native.dp_output_bytes: Actual master-to-slave cyclic user bytes, separately244 maximum.
native.dp_device_input_max: Actual GSD supported input bytes, never assumed244-device buffer.
native.dp_ident_number: Actual device Ident_Number from GSD, not assigned random16-bit identity.
native.dp_data_bits: Actual UART8 data bits per character.
native.dp_character_bits: Actual UART11 wire bits, parity included.
native.dp_sync_bits: Actual action/token preframe idle synchronisation minimum33 bits, not per response duplication.
native.dp_intra_frame_idle_bits: No idle bits between FDL UART characters.
native.dp_data_unit_bytes: Actual FDL data unit including address extensions, maximum246.

native.dp_user_bytes: Actual FDL data bytes after simple LSAP extensions, distinct whole application transfer.
native.dp_le: SD2 length DA+SA+FC+FDL data unit; excludes FCS/end/header.
native.dp_le_repeat: Repeated SD2 length must equal LE.
native.dp_frame_bytes: Whole selected FDL UART frame, sync idle excluded.
native.dp_wire_bits: Actual11 wire bits per selected UART frame byte, sync separate.
native.dp_slot_bits: TSL reply-first-character/token monitoring in bit-times; device qualifier governs bounds.
native.dp_min_tsdr_bits: Minimum responder delay in bit-times, not application source processing.
native.dp_quiet_bits: Modulator/repeater decay quiet time in bit-times.
native.dp_setup_bits: Actual station processing setup time in bit-times.
native.dp_target_rotation_bits: Actual TTR target token rotation depends traffic/station configuration; no universal preset.
native.dp_gap_factor: Actual token rotations between GAP updates.
native.dp_retry: Actual max telegram repeats after unsuccessful transfer.
native.dp_idle1_bits: Actual Tid1 inter-action idle bound35+2TSET+TQUI for selected STEP7 definition.
native.dp_idle2_bits: Actual selected STEP7 Tid2 equals maximum responder delay.
native.dp_ready_bits: Actual STEP7 TRDY equals minimum responder delay.
native.dp_watchdog_base_ms: Actual SPC3 selected1ms or10ms timebase;1ms requires capability.
native.dp_watchdog_factor2: Actual WD_Fact2; both factors1 forbidden by SPC3 specification.
native.dp_watchdog_ms: Actual DP control supervision equals base times two factors when enabled.
native.dp_baud_watchdog_units: Actual SPC3 baud-control register, each10ms; distinct DP control factors.
native.dp_baud_watchdog_ms: Actual baud-control interval10ms times configured register.
native.dp_data_control_ms: Actual master data-control supervision; distinct DP slave watchdog.
native.dp_poll_timeout_ms: Actual acyclic/receive timeout from selected device, no global10ms guarantee.
native.dp_scan_interval_us: Actual CM592-DP slave polling interval, dependent configuration.
native.dp_cable_m: Actual TypeA segment total cable length, baud dependent.
native.dp_impedance_ohm: Actual TypeA characteristic impedance, not PA80..120Ohm.
native.dp_capacitance_pf_m: Actual TypeA cable capacitance, ABB less than30pF/m.
native.dp_loop_ohm_km: Actual TypeA loop resistance, not single-conductor value.
native.dp_serialization_us: Actual selected UART frame serialization, excludes sync/turnaround/retries.
native.dp_slot_us: Actual TSL converted from bit-times, not treated as milliseconds.
native.dp_observed_response_bits: Actual response first-character bound, monitored byTSL.
native.dp_freshness_ms: Actual application freshness requirement, not a bus standard default.
native.dp_termination_powered: Both line-end termination networks remain powered.
native.dp_module_config_valid: Actual configured module layout equals slave configuration.
native.dp_frame_valid: Actual UART/SYN/length/address/FCS checked, not assumed by field presence.
native.dp_data_accepted: Actual functional consumer accepted data, not SC or link carrier.
native.dp_watchdog_enabled: Actual DP control watchdog enabled, not automatically asserted.
native.dp_supports_1ms: Actual SPC3 slave supports selected1ms watchdog base.
native.dp_watchdog_expired: Actual selected supervision expired; DATA_EXCHANGE no longer valid for SPC3 DP control.
native.bitrate: Lowest listed native DP9600baud unconfirmed proposal; agreed device rates and actual bearer/token/polling/qualified configurator determine timing.
native.payload_bytes: Whole application bytes distinct separately244cyclic input/output, FDL246dataunit/255whole UART frame and segmented acyclic data. No8byte/1500application defaults.
